description: Chord of Calling's Convoke lets each tapped creature pay {1} or one mana of that creature's color toward the spell's cost, reducing the mana actually paid from the pool.
artificial_state_elements: X=3 chosen arbitrarily to search for a mana-value-3-or-less creature; any legal X works identically for testing convoke's payment mechanic.
Two convoking creatures (one green, one off-color) chosen specifically so one pays a colored pip and the other only generic, showing convoke isn't restricted to matching colors for generic costs.
material_characteristics: Convoke lets tapping a creature substitute for paying {1} or one mana of that creature's color, as part of the total cost, not a discount applied before costs are calculated
An off-color creature (Avacyn's Pilgrim, white) can still convoke Chord of Calling (green) - it just can only pay generic, not a colored pip
abstracted_characteristics: Identity of the searched-for creature - any legal mana-value-X-or-less creature is equivalent for this test
All board state not directly involved in casting Chord of Calling

legal_actions: Cast Chord of Calling with X=3 (total cost {3}{G}{G}{G}), tapping Devoted Druid to pay {G} and Avacyn's Pilgrim to pay {1}, paying the remaining {2}{G}{G} from Forests
illegal_actions_to_reject: Tapping Avacyn's Pilgrim (white) to pay a {G} pip via convoke - an off-color creature can only pay generic mana through convoke, not colored pips outside its own color
expected.outcome_if_resolved: Chord of Calling resolves; Delighted Halfling (mana value 1, satisfies X=3 or less) found and put onto the battlefield; library shuffled.
